verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure (phone left, text column right) with a clear headline and CTA. Flaws: the SOLSTICE wordmark is centered while the rest of the text is left-aligned, the tagline is indented off the left edge, the badges sit tight under the tagline, and the phone is cramped against the top and bottom edges. B has a hierarchy and grouping failure: the CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill in the same row as the badges, so it is buried and no longer dominant. The headline wraps awkwardly to three lines, with 'back' orphaned, and fills the left half. The tagline is squeezed into a narrow three-line column, and the badge text is tiny and cramped. The layout is unbalanced and reads as a different design.
